recipe.upscale: wrapped separable Catmull-Rom, linear light, clamped to the source 2x2
recipe.sharpen: thresholded unsharp on linear luminance, clamped again
recipe.blockMean: each 4x4 block's mean restored to the source pixel it replaces, outermost output ring left alone
recipe.seamGuard: only if the finished 8-bit seam ratio exceeds 1.15x bilinear's, blend the outermost ring that far toward a plain wrapped bilinear
recipe.grain: wrapped value noise on the source grid, at most 3% of local luminance and 4/255 absolute, scaled by source 3x3 variance; off for sign/arrow/text, light, water/warp, sky and flat/black
recipe.material: materialFor(entry, source) decides one of 13 materials for every WAL. sign, water, sky and flat keep the faithful upscale and the faithful gates. Every other material is drawn by applyMaterial(base, source, material, {seed: entry.name}): relief from the base's own shading, one fixed light from the upper left, wrapped cavity occlusion, grunge, grain and edge wear, and a mean-brightness guard -- all deterministic, all tileable, all in scripts/material-lib.mjs.

textures/e1u1/wsupprt1_14.wal.why: lamp: least detail of any material entry (1.01x the smooth floor) and the largest colour move (meanAbsRgb 6.44 of 10). The bloom was most of that colour move and almost none of the detail; a quarter less glow (0.55) and a finer grain (0.05 -> 0.15) take meanAbsRgb to 3.83 and detail to 1.21x

textures/e1u1/grnx2_5.wal.why: metal: detail 1.520x, only 1.3% above the 1.5x floor; a finer grain (0.24 -> 0.32) lifts it to 1.65x without touching the relief that drives the seam

textures/e1u1/grnx3_3.wal.why: metal: detail 1.545x and the highest seam-to-base ratio of the grnx family (0.31 against the base's 0.2285). The same finer grain (0.24 -> 0.30) lifts detail to 1.65x and pulls the seam ratio down to 0.2497

textures/e1u2/metal11_3.wal.why: rust: largest hue shift in the set (2.5433° of 3°) with only 0.006 of the 0.007 bright share left. The shift came from desaturation leaving low-chroma pixels to quantise badly; less relief (7.5 -> 4), less chipped-edge desaturation (0.5 -> 0.2) and a gentler grunge pull to grey (0.15 -> 0.08) take hue to 2.03° and bright share to 0.0049

textures/e1u1/florr1_2.wal.why: stone: meanAbsRgb 5.0122, the second-largest colour move in the set, at 3.25x detail. Less cavity darkening, a lighter grime pull and a softer edge highlight take it to 3.76; a finer grain (0.24 -> 0.32) keeps detail above its old 4.83 at 4.97 (3.35x the 1.5x floor)

textures/e1u1/+0btshoot2.wal.why: tech: meanAbsRgb 4.9447, hue 1.9925° and a bright-pixel share already at its 0.013. Softer relief (6 -> 3) and less grime (0.7 -> 0.5) take rgb to 4.33, hue to 1.81° and bright share to 0.0128. The toggle partner +abtshoot2 is not an animation frame and keeps its own art

textures/e1u1/color1_2.wal.why: rust: 99th-percentile chroma 88 against an allowance of 93.2 (94.4%). The edge highlight was the main chroma source: a softer edge (0.45 -> 0.15) and 1% more pull toward each pixel's own grey take it to 86 (92.3%), and a finer grain (0.32 -> 0.36) keeps detail at 4.85 (2.91x)

textures/e1u1/+0comp10_1.wal.why: tech animation family: chroma 97 against the 103.1 allowance. One recipe for all five frames: the edge highlight was most of the chroma, so edge 0.45 -> 0.2 with 1.2% more pull toward grey takes it to 94, and the colour move drops too (meanAbsRgb 2.43 -> 2.35)

textures/e1u1/+1comp10_1.wal.why: tech animation family: same recipe as +0comp10_1, chroma 98 -> 94

textures/e1u1/+2comp10_1.wal.why: tech animation family: same recipe as +0comp10_1, chroma 98 -> 95

textures/e1u1/+3comp10_1.wal.why: tech animation family: same recipe as +0comp10_1, chroma 97 -> 94

textures/e1u1/+4comp10_1.wal.why: tech animation family: same recipe as +0comp10_1, chroma 97 -> 94

textures/e1u1/wgrate1_8.wal.why: rust: largest luminance bias among material entries (0.9465 of 2) with detail at 1.589x. The bias was inherited from the faithful base's own mean, so the mean guard now aims one level lower (bias -1) and the grain goes finer (0.32 -> 0.38): bias 0.022, detail 1.68x

textures/e1u1/pip01_1.wal.why: rust: lowest Pearson correlation in the set (0.9008 against the 0.9 floor). Most of the structure the pass imposed was relief the source did not have: relief 7.5 -> 3 with a slightly finer grain (0.32 -> 0.34) and a softer edge lifts r to 0.9359 with detail at 4.55, above its old 4.54 (4.88x)

recipe.materialGates: material art is held to the realism gates instead of gate 4 (source 3x3 envelope) and gate 5 (bilinear gradient)
